content.short: Vertex is a high-performance cross-margin DEX on Arbitrum and Ink offering spot, perpetuals, and money markets.
content.description:
Vertex is a premier decentralized exchange designed to provide a professional-grade trading experience with the speed and efficiency typically found only on centralized venues. Utilizing a unique hybrid architecture that combines an off-chain sequencer for sub-30ms order matching with secure on-chain settlement, the platform supports spot assets, perpetual futures, and an integrated money market. All services are unified under a single cross-margin account, allowing users to maximize their capital efficiency across all trades.

Originally built on Arbitrum, Vertex has expanded its ecosystem to Mantle and Base, and has announced a primary migration to the Ink network (Kraken's L2). The protocol focuses on institutional-grade risk management and deep liquidity, serving as a vital venue for sophisticated DeFi participants. Through its commitment to technological innovation and high-frequency execution, Vertex is building the essential infrastructure for the next generation of decentralized finance, empowering participants to trade with unparalleled precision and security.
content.meta: Vertex offers high-speed decentralized perpetuals and spot trading with a unified cross-margin account across multiple L2s.
